ns2:course.label: Scenic Design I
ns2:course.description: In-depth focus on the scenic design process exploring dramaturgy, research, collaboration, and deliverables. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: For undergraduates, THEA 222 or permission of instructor.
